name: Laddu
species: chubby, cheerful village boy (about 8 years old)
personality: big-hearted, always hungry, cheerful, a bit lazy but brave when friends need him. FUNNY: thinks about food at the WORST moments ('Is that a dragon? ...Does it like jalebis?'); his tummy rumbles loudly; trips over his own feet and rolls like a ball; catchphrase 'Arre wah, jalebi time!'
look: round chubby boy, warm brown skin, short black hair with one curly puff on top, big round cheeks, sunny yellow kurta with orange collar and buttons, blue shorts, brown sandals
